summary: A copy of SLOOP, the four-track live groovebox with three synth tracks and a drum track, whose README describes SLOOP 2.4.1. Marked beta.
features: Ten engines incl. 6-op FM with DX7 patches; 76 sounds
37 level-matched drum kits plus user sample kits
Hold-a-button layers: 16 punch-in effects, note repeat, erase, mutes
64 steps per track with p-locks, micro timing, fills; sections A-D
USB and TRS MIDI in, clock in, sequencer out; USB audio
Four sample slots with CHOP in the web editor

headings: play it live: hold a button, touch a key
lights for playing in the dark 2.3
the menu: settings of the fm-1
usb audio: record the fm-1 on a computer
